name: levels-top
what: The top of a flow that reads flows, on a normal day (ADR 0026 §3): each flow it reads is one card, a second sheet behind it, with FLOW and the count of what it gives, a tick and what it has; the posture product's own files and notebooks beside them. Nothing of a read flow is drawn here but its card

name: levels-paused
what: The day that waits (ADR 0026 §3): the flow whose file holds says so on its card, by the month's mark and in colour, with its extent counted (1 of 13); the flows that read nothing of that file are normal

name: levels-sheet
what: A flow's sheet, from its card (ADR 0026 §4): what its day came to as a state and its extent, never a score; Open the flow; what holds it, a tap from the card inside; the flows it reads, each with its own day; what it gives, each with whether today's went out and who reads it; the hash it is known by

text: Its files are sealed: each matches the data’s list, as the engine hashed it.
Read by Larkspur estate, Applications. Known by
the same flow, with the same hash, wherever it is read.

name: levels-holds-inside
what: What holds a flow is a tap from the card inside that holds (ADR 0026 §4): the canvas goes into the flow, a line at the top says where you are and what the flow made of the day, and the file's own sheet opens

name: levels-inside
what: Inside Evidence feeds (ADR 0026 §4): its thirteen files, its notebook and the flow it reads as a card that leads the canvas, joined to the notebook whose gates count each file against the inventory; the day's head and Decide as at the top; arranging is the top level's

name: levels-up
what: The line at the top goes back (ADR 0026 §4): up to the flow that reads this one

name: levels-double-click
what: On a desktop a double-click on a flow's card enters it (ADR 0026 §4): Applications reads the other three, each a card inside it

name: levels-open-button
what: On a phone the sheet's button enters (ADR 0026 §4), as on any size

name: levels-nested
what: A flow read by two flows is one flow (ADR 0026 §1): inside Applications, Evidence feeds is the same card with the same day, and opens to the same canvas, the line at the top saying the way in

name: levels-next-day
what: Stepping to the next day stays inside the flow on screen (ADR 0026 §4): each level has a link, and the day's buttons keep it

name: levels-reload
what: A level's link opens it again (ADR 0026 §4): after a reload the page is on the same day, inside the same flow

name: levels-card-from-top
what: A card inside a read flow, opened from anywhere, is on the canvas behind its sheet: the canvas goes to the flow that has it

name: levels-decided
what: A paused day once decided (ADR 0026 §3): Mon Mar 11's first files, the backup feed filled from the day before: the flow's card says how its day went out, by the month's decided mark, in the ink

name: levels-decided-sheet
what: Its sheet says the same in a sentence, and what held it

name: levels-dark
what: The same in the dark scheme: the flows' cards, the day that waits in colour
